== Historical card identities and deck-table verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-retro-world-championship-ds-jeremy-christoffel-set-your-course-for-alderaan/ published Retro decklist] and [[Media:26RWC Christoffel DS SYCFA.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] each contain 60 cards. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114003639/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-retro-world-championship-ds-jeremy-christoffel-set-your-course-for-alderaan.html Players Committee decklist].
The article retains those quantities and the original download bytes (SHA-256 <code>f567a5390235dc78645598963cc40658ed06045a8ce4c3bbb51c98598c109130</code>). The original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.

Every linked card family was compared with the XML blueprint code. Existing Decipher printed articles were retained for the [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format; an unqualified XML code was not used to substitute a Modern Players Committee erratum. All 48 deck rows have card-image hovers bound to the same linked historical article. Card-type blocks and their contents are alphabetical, with whole blocks balanced between the columns.

The metadata names the Objective listed in the post and XML. It does not assert a separately sourced starting-location choice.
